boundary_evidence: The class's run plus the helper immediately below it: func_02055998 at 0x02055998 through PerspectiveW_ ending at 0x02055dec. config/arm9/symbols.txt records exactly two _ZN3G3i symbols, both here; func_02055998 keeps its existing name.
GXS::EndLoadOBJExtPltt (0x02055dec) is the neighbour above and belongs to GXS's OBJ-extended-palette loader set. func_0205583c below has no class affinity and stays out.
No lifecycle or RTTI: G3i has no instance state and no virtuals (include/G3i.h documents the all-static shape), so the two members plus func_02055998 are the whole .text.

compiler_only_output.reason: LookAt_ declares three stack Vector3s; types.h gives Vector3 a non-trivial (empty) destructor, so the front end emits D1 in this TU but elides every call site. The cartridge body (four bytes, bx lr) has a configured home at 0x020072c0 owned by src/_ZN7Vector3D1Ev.cpp, so this emitted copy deadstrips as a duplicate.

notes: Hand-assembled, not generated by `tubuild.py create`: tu_map cannot segment arm9/main, so there was no candidate id to create from. The schema follows the arm9/G2x entry, which took the same route.

G3i is the geometry engine's immediate-mode matrix writer set. LookAt_ composes the camera basis (right/up2/forward via CrossVec3/NormalizeVec3/DotVec3) and streams it to the position-matrix port 0x400045c under matrix mode 2; PerspectiveW_ runs the 64-bit division unit at 0x4000290 for cot/depth terms and streams the projection rows to 0x4000458 under mode 0. Both optionally mirror the matrix into a caller Matrix4x3.

PerspectiveW_ is G3i::PerspectiveW_(Fix12i, Fix12i, Fix12i, Fix12i, Fix12i, Fix12i, int, Matrix4x3 *), a real static method: the load flag is the SDK's BOOL, an int. With a bool flag the method body differs from the ROM, which is why it was once a C-linkage body spelled `...bP9Matrix4x3`; with int it matches, the matrix walked through an int * local. .cpp callers use the method; .c callers use the mangled identifier.

The file is written ROM-descending because mwccarm emits .text in reverse source order under default deferred codegen; the emitted object carries the three functions ascending 0x02055998..0x02055dec. absorb/G3i folds func_02055998 in under its existing name (probe C++OK:hoist, body unchanged, extern "C").
